# 增加方向
bca_jr_apply_inc_gears = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            check_variable_arithmetic = {
                which = $TARGET$
                value >= 3200
            }
        }
        set_carrier_flag = bca_jr_inc_$JOB$_g3200
        add_variable = {
            which = bca_jr_actual_job_change
            value = 3200
        }
        subtract_variable = {
            which = $TARGET$
            value = 3200
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = {
            check_variable_arithmetic = {
                which = $TARGET$
                value >= 800
            }
        }
        set_carrier_flag = bca_jr_inc_$JOB$_g800
        add_variable = {
            which = bca_jr_actual_job_change
            value = 800

        subtract_variable = {
            which = $TARGET$
            value = 800
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = {
            check_variable_arithmetic = {
                which = $TARGET$
                value >= 200
            }
        }
        set_carrier_flag = bca_jr_inc_$JOB$_g200
        add_variable = {
            which = bca_jr_actual_job_change
            value = 200
        }
        subtract_variable = {
            which = $TARGET$
            value = 200
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = {
            check_variable_arithmetic = {
                which = $TARGET$
                value >= 50
            }
        }
        set_carrier_flag = bca_jr_inc_$JOB$_g50
        add_variable = {
            which = bca_jr_actual_job_change
            value = 50

            value = 50
        }

}
